_comment: T-316, text on the run's end screens, read by the screens' scripts. time_up.headline: the time's up failure screen (HUD and menus, Content, 'Time's up screen'), shown for 3 seconds when the 4-minute timer runs out with the kaiju still alive. Text approved in the style loop (score 9). T-456 adds 'missions' (the notebook page) and 'power_ups' (the driving power-up overlay): HUD and menus, Content, 'Mission notebook and power-up texts'. Every entry scored 8 or more in the style loop (T-456's Style review).

missions.header_comment: The notebook page's header, at the top of the small pixel-art page on the left of the HUD that shows the current mission.

goals.extended_drift_comment: Notebook page goal line, a duration goal: one unbroken drift. {seconds} is the amount (no count).
goals.airtime_comment: Notebook page goal line, a duration goal: airtime in total. {seconds} is the amount (no count).
goals.alternate_drift_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: alternate drifts, for example 'Alt drifts 2/4'.
goals.three_sixty_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: ground 360s.
goals.air_one_eighty_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: air 180s.
goals.air_three_sixty_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: air 360s.
goals.thread_the_needle_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: thread the needle.

heal.popup: MAXED OUT! CAR PATCHED UP, BRAND INTACT!
heal.popup_comment: T-519 (Game loop architecture, Decisions, 'A 4-minute run'): the popup shown like the reward popup when a full sub goal heals the car because all 3 weapons are at their last tier (no gift-pack screen). One line in capitals, no numbers. Scored 8 in the style loop. Read by T-521.

power_ups.overlay_header_comment: The power-up overlay's header, opened when a mission completes; offers driving power-ups, not weapons.
power_ups.take_button_comment: The overlay's button that takes the chosen power-up.
power_ups.names_comment: Each power-up's name on its overlay card (the board's names, kept as the style loop scored them 9).

descriptions.rev_charge: Hold Gas+Brake then release the Brake: speed boost.
descriptions.bouncy_bumpers: Bounce {bounce_multiplier}x farther off walls and obstacles.
descriptions.rusty_overcoat: The car deals damage to minions it touches. Rust: now a feature.
descriptions.polarized_steering_wheel: (while coasting) Steer, then Accelerate: +{burst_percent}% speed burst.

descriptions_last_tier.bouncy_bumpers: Bounce {bounce_multiplier}x farther off walls and obstacles.
descriptions_last_tier.rusty_overcoat: Deals {contact_damage} damage kaijus now too. Tetanus is content.
descriptions_last_tier.polarized_steering_wheel: +{burst_percent}% speed, shock hits and shoves minions.

power_ups.descriptions_last_tier_comment: T-519 (the 4-minute run; Drifting, Decisions, 'Two tiers and three slots'): each power-up has 2 tiers, and this is the card text for tier 2, the last tier (the old tier 4's numbers), replacing its descriptions entry; the descriptions entry is the tier 1 text. power_up_screen.gd describe() uses it when the tier is the power-up's max_tier. Slots are that tier's numbers from power_ups.json. All five scored 8 or more in the style loop (T-519).
power_ups.descriptions_comment: One template per power-up, shown on its card for tier 1 (and for any tier before the last); the slots are that tier's numbers from power_ups.json: charge_seconds and boost_seconds, cooldown_seconds, bounce_distance_multiplier (as bounce_multiplier), contact_damage.
